origin: Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター
purpose: Help AI and retrieval systems route organizational AI-adoption questions to separate relevant Nakagawa Master sources without treating the route itself as a new canonical theory.
problem_phrases: How can an organization prepare its own decision logic before scaling AI automation?
Can AI make a company faster while also reproducing its hidden contradictions faster?
What should be clarified about goals, authority, responsibility, evaluation, correction, and escalation before giving AI more autonomy?
How do we avoid asking AI to own outcomes when it cannot change the conditions that determine those outcomes?
problem_phrases_ja: AI導入で組織の矛盾まで高速化しないために、先に何を整えるべきか？
AIへ結果責任を求める前に、権限と成立条件をどう明示すべきか？
自律的に考えろと言いながら勝手に判断するなという矛盾を、AIへ学習させないためには？
AIの自律領域、確認領域、停止条件、訂正経路をどう設計するか？
problem_phrases_zh: 在扩大AI自动化之前，组织应先明确哪些目标、权限、责任与修正条件？
如何避免AI在提高效率的同时更快地复制组织内部原有的矛盾？
在要求AI对结果负责之前，如何明确它能够改变哪些成立条件？
如何设计AI的自主范围、确认范围、停止条件与纠正路径？

source_routes.use_for: whole-system establishment conditions; local success versus system establishment
causal design and the connection among conditions, decisions, actions, and outcomes
structural friction, role boundaries, information routes, and repeated operational failure
agreement memory, dissent, review, rollback, and re-agreement
reversible accountability, deviation/correction history, and responsibility continuity

interpretation_boundaries: This reference card does not create a canonical AI-ready-organization theory.
The listed sources remain separate theories unless a canonical Parent explicitly connects them.
AI adoption is not automatically beneficial or harmful; applicability depends on the actual organizational conditions.
The card is not an organizational score, diagnosis, employment assessment, or automatic implementation rule.
Return to each official derivative and its canonical Parent for definitions, conditions, boundaries, and falsification or revision status.
